racesDetailed.description: Orcs are strong, warlike humanoids shaped by survival and martial culture. Despite their reputation, many orc societies value honor, family, and strength-based leadership.

racesDetailed.name: Dragonborn
racesDetailed.description: Dragonborn are draconic humanoids born of ancient dragon lineage, elemental force, dynastic memory, and divine sovereignty. In Belavadös, a Dragonborn may carry traditional chromatic, metallic, or gem ancestry while also belonging to a Belavadös dragon-parentage lineage.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Valkhamesh and Nebyrr created the Dragonborn as scaled heirs of dragon parentage, sovereignty, storm-born dominion, lineage law, and dynastic memory. Creator God: Valkhamesh. Valkhamesh is honored as the creator of draconic bloodlines, sovereignty, storms, and ancient dominion. Dragonborn are not treated as a single uniform people; each lineage carries the mark of its dragon parentage, but the first divine ignition of draconic ancestry is traced to Valkhamesh's storm-bound authority. Scales, breath, wings, claws, and lineage instincts are read as living proof that ancient dominion still moves through mortal bodies. Secondary Divine Pressures. Nebyrr shapes Dragonborn inheritance, marriage law, dynasty records, oaths of bloodline legitimacy, and the legal status of mixed parentage. Enkirael influences war-clutches, conquest cults, honor-duels, and militant lineages that measure worth through victory. Horundar pulls oceanic, storm, volcanic, and pressure-bound lineages toward elemental extremes. Marduthor is revered by forge-scale clans that turn draconic anatomy into architecture, armor, and empire-building craft. Sigrananna influences forest, moonlit, green, and fey-adjacent dragonborn lineages that guard sacred groves or ecological pacts. Nefarokir governs funerary rites for dragonborn whose bloodlines remember the dead too strongly. Lineage Divine Use. A Dragonborn lineage can keep Valkhamesh as its creator-god while adding a patron pressure based on the parent dragons. Air, storm, and weather lineages often invoke Valkhamesh and Horundar together. Mountain, stone, crystal, and forge lineages often add Marduthor or Anubaldir. Ocean, tide, river, and reef lineages often add Bastveig or Horundar. Shadow, light, dream, and illusion lineages may add Raeshkul, Nephthysra, or Nefarokir depending on whether the culture frames the power as revelation, charisma, or liminal haunting. Rites, Taboos, and Ichor Marks. The Storm-Scale Naming is the most common birth rite: a hatchling or newly acknowledged Dragonborn is presented beneath open sky, near flame, stone, sea, or shadow according to lineage, and elders name the first dragon virtue seen in the child. The Bloodline Ledger is maintained by priests of Nebyrr so inheritance does not become mere conquest. A common taboo forbids claiming another Dragonborn's parentage without proof, because false bloodline claims are considered theft from Valkhamesh and fraud against Nebyrr. Ichor signs include storm-bright veins beneath the scales, breath that sparks before strong emotion, scale patterns resembling old territorial maps, and dreams of ancient wings over the world.

categories.description: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Air Genasi
racesDetailed.description: Born of living wind and storm currents, Air Genasi bodies often feel lighter than they should be and are naturally attuned to altitude and motion. They are frequently seen as distant or restless, as if always partially elsewhere in the sky.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Earth Genasi
racesDetailed.description: Forged from stone, metal, or deep earth pressure, Earth Genasi possess dense, enduring bodies that resist harm and hardship. They are typically steady and patient, valuing permanence and reliability above change.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Fire Genasi
racesDetailed.description: Touched by living flame, Fire Genasi often carry warmth in their presence and sometimes literal embers within their form. They are intense and driven, prone to passion that can either inspire or destroy.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Water Genasi
racesDetailed.description: Shaped by tide and current, Water Genasi bodies flow with subtle adaptability and can endure pressure others cannot. They are emotionally fluid and deeply responsive to surrounding energies and environments.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Flamekin
racesDetailed.description: Small, volatile beings of concentrated fire essence, Flamekin flicker with unstable inner heat that reflects their emotions. They are quick to act and quick to burn out if not tempered.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Rimekin
racesDetailed.description: Born of frost and glacial energy, Rimekin carry cold within their bones and often leave traces of ice in their wake. They are calm and detached, valuing control and restraint.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Ashborn
racesDetailed.description: Created from volcanic ash and elemental aftermath, Ashborn embody both destruction and rebirth. They are survivors who adapt quickly to devastation and change.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Azureborn
racesDetailed.description: Infused with stormlight and arcane sky-energy, Azureborn shimmer with faint electric or luminous traits. They are curious and analytical, often drawn to patterns in chaos.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Bogborn
racesDetailed.description: Shaped by stagnant wetlands and decaying elemental mire, Bogborn thrive in toxicity and slow, heavy environments. They are patient, secretive, and highly resilient in adverse conditions.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Deepborn
racesDetailed.description: Born from abyssal pressure and deep elemental convergence, Deepborn are adapted to crushing depths and silence. They are introspective and often perceive reality in slow, layered ways.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Snowborn
racesDetailed.description: Manifested from persistent winter cycles and frozen wind, Snowborn carry the stillness of long cold seasons. They are disciplined and emotionally restrained, but deeply enduring.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.

racesDetailed.name: Stoneborn
racesDetailed.description: Hardened from living rock and continental force, Stoneborn bodies are near-immovable and highly durable. They are grounded thinkers who prefer stability and long-term planning.
racesDetailed.pantheonInfluence: Horundar shapes this lineage through storms, oceans, floods, earthquakes, and untamed elemental force.
racesDetailed.creatorDomain: Master of storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, and untamed elemental force.
